C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the deadline to reserve the
graduation street banners is September 5 and they can be picked on September 12; and that the youth
flag football and volleyball registration closes on September 6.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that two crossing guards are at each elementary
school and encouraged the community to use the crosswalk.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, announced the completion and sign­off of 6 homes
on Pioneer Blvd., 3 single­family homes with ADUs in the back; and provided an update on ADU
applications, beautification program; and new permitting software.

Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, provided an update on the YEP program, finance system, and fee
study.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no Oral City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor De Paula announced that ABC Unified School District will host a Parent Advisory Leadership
training on September 4; and reported that he attended Pow Wow, a private community­organized
event.

H.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 6:34 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, September 10, 2025 at 6:00 PM
